constraints.ocl:
context Rental
inv: self.isCompleted implies self.payment <> null

context Branch
inv: (self.reservations->any(x | x.estimatedCost <= 50) <> null) and (self.isOpen = true)

context Customer
inv: (self.rentals->collect(x | x.lateFee)->notEmpty()) and (self.age mod 2 = 0)

context Reservation
inv: (self.vehicle.branch = self.branch) and (self.isConfirmed <> null)

context Branch
inv: (self.vehicles->collect(x | x.rentals)->size() >= 1) and (self.vehicleCount mod 2 = 0)

context Customer
inv: self.rentalCount >= 14 and self.rentalCount <= 23

context Branch
inv: self.rentals->size() >= 1 and self.rentals->size() <= 3

context Customer
inv: (if self.depositAmount < self.balance then self.depositAmount else self.balance endif >= 26) and (self.age mod 2 = 0)

context Branch
inv: self.capacity <= self.staffCount and self.staffCount <= self.vehicleCount

context Branch
inv: self.capacity <= self.vehicleCount and self.vehicleCount <= self.staffCount

context Payment
inv: self.amount <= self.tax and self.tax <= self.discount

context Customer
inv: self.loyaltyPoints >= 25 and self.loyaltyPoints <= 74

context Rental
inv: self.depositPaid <= self.totalAmount and self.totalAmount <= self.lateFee

context Payment
inv: self.tax <> null and self.discount <> null

context Payment
inv: self.amount <> null implies self.tax <> null

context Rental
inv: self.fuelCharge <> null implies self.depositPaid <> null

context Branch
inv: self.staffCount <> null and self.vehicleCount <> null

context Payment
inv: self.tax <> null implies self.discount <> null

context Rental
inv: self.depositPaid <> null implies self.fuelCharge <> null

context Payment
inv: self.amount <> null and self.discount <> null

context Customer
inv: (self.reservations->one(x | x.estimatedCost > 1)) and (self.isPremium = true)

context Company
inv: (self.branches->any(x | x.vehicleCount >= 0) <> null) and (self.branches->collect(x | x.staffCount)->notEmpty())

context Payment
inv: self.discount >= 51 and self.discount <= 97

context Payment
inv: (self.discount <> null and self.amount <> null) and (not(self.discount <> null and self.amount <> null))

context Company
inv: (self.branches->select(x | x.monthlyRevenue >= 5)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.branches->select(x | x.monthlyRevenue >= 5)->size() >= 1))

context Branch
inv: ((self.vehicles->one(x | x.doors >= 0)) and (self.staffCount mod 2 = 0)) and (not((self.vehicles->one(x | x.doors >= 0)) and (self.staffCount mod 2 = 0)))

context Company
inv: (self.branches->forAll(x | x.vehicleCount < 10)) and (self.branches->exists(x | not(x.vehicleCount < 10)))

context Rental
inv: (self.fuelCharge <= self.totalAmount) and (not(self.fuelCharge <= self.totalAmount))

context Customer
inv: (self.depositAmount >= 31 and self.depositAmount <= 67) and (self.depositAmount < 31)

context Rental
inv: ((self.vehicle.branch = self.branch) and (self.fuelCharge < 87)) and (self.fuelCharge > 92)

context Rental
inv: ((self.vehicle.branch = self.branch) and (self.isCompleted implies self.payment <> null)) and (not((self.vehicle.branch = self.branch) and (self.isCompleted implies self.payment <> null)))

context Branch
inv: (self.reservations->select(x | x.estimatedCost >= 5)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.reservations->select(x | x.estimatedCost >= 5)->size() >= 1))

context Branch
inv: (self.vehicles->select(x | x.weightKg < 1000)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.vehicles->select(x | x.weightKg < 1000)->size() >= 1))

context Branch
inv: (self.vehicles->exists(x | x.seats > 0)) and (not(self.vehicles->exists(x | x.seats > 0)))

context Branch
inv: ((self.reservations->collect(x | x.estimatedCost)->sum() >= 2) and (self.company.oclIsTypeOf(Company))) and (not((self.reservations->collect(x | x.estimatedCost)->sum() >= 2) and (self.company.oclIsTypeOf(Company))))

context Branch
inv: (self.reservations->forAll(x | x.estimatedCost > 0)) and (self.reservations->exists(x | not(x.estimatedCost > 0)))

context Branch
inv: (self.company.isActive <> true) and (not(self.company.isActive <> true))

context Branch
inv: ((self.monthlyRevenue > 2) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost < 10))) and (self.monthlyRevenue < -3)

context Reservation
inv: (self.isConfirmed implies self.vehicle <> null) and (not(self.isConfirmed implies self.vehicle <> null))

context Company
inv: (self.branches->size() >= 2 and self.branches->size() <= 3) and (self.branches->size() < 2)
